children.game_version: Follow the leader in a 'New Road' parade, focusing on the 'wiggle' (hip tilt).

avoid: Long periods of standing without support
seniors.seated_version: Perform the hip tilts and arm movements while seated, using the feet to tap the 2/4 rhythm.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the walk with a smaller range of motion, using a chair for balance if needed.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Maintain the slow tempo; reduce the depth of the hip tilts.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Holding hands in a curved line
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Curved line moving to the dancer's right
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Sensuous hip tilts synchronized with the walking rhythm
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low to the ground; no jumps described
movement_profile.posture: Upright but relaxed to allow for hip movement

signature_moves.description: A rhythmic, sensuous inclination of the hips performed while walking
signature_moves.name: Hip Tilt

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid stiffening the torso; the dance requires fluid hip movement.

music_profile.sound_description: A slow, driving 2/4 beat led by heavy brass instruments, creating a soulful and rhythmic atmosphere typical of Balkan Romani music.
music_profile.vocal_style: Often instrumental, but can be accompanied by Romani vocals

basic_steps: Form a curved line holding hands with neighbors
Begin a slow walking step moving toward the right
Incorporate a rhythmic tilt of the hips with each step
Complete the six-measure step pattern before repeating
teaching.level_notes: Focus on the fluidity of the hips rather than the complexity of the feet.
